notes: Data-driven console launcher. 'command' is a bare executable name resolved on PATH before launch; 'arguments' is a list and is never parsed from a string, so nothing in this file can become a shell command. Inside an argument, %VAR% is expanded and {workdir} becomes the project folder. 'environment' is applied to the CHILD process only - the launcher's own environment is never modified, an empty value removes the variable from the child, and HOME is refused outright. 'requires_path' must exist before launch; the first existing 'script_candidates' path becomes {script}; 'ensure_directories' are created before launch. Profiles are non-elevated unless they declare requires_admin, and no profile here declares it. A profile with 'provider' declares which local identity it already claims, so a canonical account pointing at the same profile directory is shown once instead of twice; display name is never a matching key. A profile with 'expand_accounts' is a TEMPLATE: it renders one concrete profile per canonical account of that provider and carries no command at all - the executable comes from the SAI Accounts engine resolver, never from this file. The templates contribute nothing when the control plane is not installed: every local profile here works standalone. The Explorer cascade (Installers\INSTALL_CONSOLES_MENU.PS1) lists every enabled profile in file order, labelled from the i18n bundle key menu.open_in.

profiles.label: Claude 2
profiles.description: Claude Code on the second account configuration directory, permission prompts bypassed. Isolation is at launcher level: the child process gets its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and nothing else is changed.

profiles.description: Codex CLI on the isolated second account (CODEX_HOME=.codex-account2), inherited API keys removed. Sign in from the Codex TUI on first start.
